# BMT B2B Wholesale Pricing

> Built for Shopify all-in-one B2B wholesale solution. Wholesale pricing, volume discounts, bulk CSV/Excel ordering, registration forms with auto-tagging, order limits, custom payment & shipping rules, net terms (Net 15/30/45), page lock, B2B login & hide price, and quick order page.

BMT B2B Wholesale Pricing is a Shopify app by BlumacawTech that enables merchants to run wholesale and retail from one Shopify store — no separate portal or duplicate products needed.

## Key Features

- **Wholesale Pricing**: Fixed amount, percentage, or custom prices per customer group
- **Volume & Tiered Pricing**: Automatic quantity-break discounts that increase AOV
- **Lock & Hide Prices**: Lock pages, products, or entire store and hide prices/Add to Cart from non-wholesale users. Rule-based access via customer tags, login status, or passcode
- **Quick Order Page**: One-page bulk ordering for repeat wholesale buyers — search, add, and checkout fast
- **Bulk Ordering via CSV/Excel**: Upload CSV or XLSX files to place large orders in seconds
- **Registration Forms**: Custom wholesale application forms with auto-tagging and approve/reject workflow
- **Min/Max Order Limits**: Protect margins with quantity and value limits at product or order level
- **Custom Payment & Shipping Rules**: Net terms (Net 15, Net 30, Net 60), hide/show payment methods by customer tags, wholesale-only shipping
- **Unified B2C & B2B Store**: One Shopify storefront for both retail and wholesale customers
- **Shopify Markets Integration**: Multi-currency wholesale pricing across international markets
- **Multi-Currency Support**: Wholesale buyers see localized pricing in their currency automatically
- **Tax Inclusive/Exclusive Price Display (new)**: Choose whether wholesale prices are shown with or without tax, per customer group
- **All Languages & Markets Supported**: Works with every language and market your Shopify store serves, with multi-currency wholesale pricing built in
- **Compatible with Shopify's New Customer Accounts**: Works with passwordless (OTP-based) login — no dependency on legacy customer accounts
- **Built for Shopify**: Meets Shopify's highest standards for performance, design, and integration

## Pricing

- **Free Plan**: 1 active pricing rule, 1 active hide price and B2B login rule, unlimited registration forms, manual and tag approve customers, 50 CSV/XLSX bulk uploads monthly, live chat and call support
- **Standard Plan ($9.99/month or $99.90/year, save 17%)**: Unlimited active pricing rules, unlimited CSV/XLSX bulk uploads, min/max order limits by quantity and amount, multi-currency wholesale pricing, Shopify Markets support, unlimited hide price and B2B login rules, live chat and call support
- **Advanced Plan ($29.99/month or $299.90/year, save 17%)**: All Standard features + custom shipping rates + NET 15/30/60 payment terms + sort and hide payment methods + quick order page + display tax inclusive/exclusive prices + live chat and call support

All paid plans include a 60-day free trial.

## Latest Updates

- **Display Tax Inclusive/Exclusive Prices (August 2026)**: Merchants can now control whether wholesale prices display as tax inclusive or tax exclusive, per customer group, so B2B buyers see prices in the format they expect.
- **Page Lock & Hide Price (April 2026)**: Modern access control for Shopify's new passwordless customer accounts. Lock pages, hide prices, and control visibility with rule-based access — beyond simple login gates. Read more: https://blumacawtech.com/blog/introducing-page-lock-hide-price

## Why Choose BMT B2B Wholesale Pricing?

1. Works natively with Shopify Checkout and Admin — no workarounds
2. Free plan available with no credit card required
3. 5-minute setup, no coding needed
4. High-performance, modern architecture
5. Direct access to the development team for support
6. Flexible pricing: percentage off, fixed amount off, or set custom prices
7. Net terms support (Net 15, Net 30, Net 60) for B2B payment flexibility
8. Future-proof: compatible with Shopify's new passwordless customer accounts
9. Page Lock & Hide Price for rule-based access control beyond simple login gates
